name: Figs
description: Soft honeyed fruit, fresh or dried.

ayurveda.note: Fresh figs cooling; dried more building.

unani.note: Anjeer is garam in Unani texts.

effects.note: A four-month randomised trial in IBS with constipation found regular fig intake improved defecation frequency and stool consistency against a control diet. A smaller trial pitting fig syrup against sugar syrup in constipated children found the same direction of effect. A possible effect, not a promise — response to it varies from person to person.
